edits.instructionEn: Turn only the small upper-left crown of green leaves to golden orange, keeping branches and leaf shapes.

edits.descriptionKo: 왼쪽 나무의 오른쪽 가는 가지가 없어졌어요.
edits.instructionEn: Remove the thin bare twig that extends right from the large foreground tree around x22 y48 and restore the storm sky.

edits.descriptionKo: 아래쪽 부러진 나무의 뾰족한 가지가 없어졌어요.
edits.instructionEn: Remove just the upward-pointing broken fork on the foreground dead tree stump near x33 y76, restoring the foliage behind it.

edits.descriptionKo: 앞쪽 큰 바위의 색이 붉게 바뀌었어요.
edits.instructionEn: Recolor the exposed face of the small foreground boulder near x51 y89 to rusty red, keeping its cracks and shading.

edits.descriptionKo: 화가 곁의 작은 상자가 파란색으로 바뀌었어요.
edits.instructionEn: Recolor only the small painting equipment box near the tiny painter around x56 y91 to cobalt blue; preserve the painter.
Recolor the light fabric of the folded umbrella on the right foreground rock to muted red; preserve its long pole.

edits.descriptionKo: 강 오른쪽 아래의 작은 배가 없어졌어요.
edits.instructionEn: Remove the tiny dark rowing boat at the lower-right river around x93 y94 and restore matching blue-gray water.

edits.descriptionKo: 강 굽이의 작은 배에 붉은 돛이 생겼어요.
edits.instructionEn: Give the tiny boat in the middle river bend near x68 y76 a small triangular red sail, painted in the same distant scale.

edits.descriptionKo: 강 안쪽 밭 한 구역이 초록색으로 바뀌었어요.
edits.instructionEn: Recolor just the rectangular golden tilled field inside the river bend near x62 y72 to deep green while preserving field rows and trees.

edits.descriptionKo: 오른쪽 하늘에 작은 새 두 마리가 생겼어요.
edits.instructionEn: Add two small dark birds in flight to the otherwise empty pale sky near x86 y24; subtle painted V-shaped silhouettes, no other sky changes.
